اقتبلن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَبَلْنَ (iqtabalna) /iq.ta.bal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# اُقْتُبِلْنَ (uqtubilna) /uq.tu.bil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# اِقْتَبِلْنَ (iqtabilna) /iq.ta.bil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
